'''Philip Green''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[October 2000 Pleasanton tournament]] on 28 October 2000 with [[My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive|My Kind Of Scum Tuskens]], according to Nick Stefanko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1396">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-29-pleasanton-ca-10-28-00d1396/ pleasanton-ca-10-28-00], DeckTech (Nick "JediBrain" Stefanko, 29 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-29-pleasanton-ca-10-28-00d1396/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
